arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test {:>10} more carefully
r = parse.parse('{:>10}', 'hello')
print(f'parse(\"{{:>10}}\", \"hello\") = {r}')

# Try with more characters
r = parse.parse('{:>10}', '       hello')  # 7 spaces + hello = 12 chars
print(f'parse(\"{{:>10}}\", \"       hello\") = {r}')

# Check the expression generated
p = parse.Parser('{:>10}')
print(f'Expression for {{:>10}}: {p._expression}')

p = parse.Parser('{:d}')
print(f'Expression for {{:d}}: {p._expression}')
"
